description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Freudenberg Performance Materials is a leading global supplier of innovative technical textiles for the markets of automotive, building materials, apparel, energy, filter media, healthcare, building interiors, shoe and leather goods as well as specialties. The company generates sales of approx. 1.6 billion euros, has 32 production sites in 14 countries around the world and more than 5,000 employees. Freudenberg Performance Materials attaches great importance to social and ecological responsibility as the basis for its business success.

You support our team as Manager Operational Procurement

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the Operational Procurement team (incl. order processing, delivery tracking, master data, etc.) with the goal to further professionalize and standardize operational procurement processes across the ACEMEA region.
  • Ensure the reliable, efficient, and timely delivery of procurement services to internal customers (Production, Supply Chain, Export Control) while maintaining compliance with corporate standards and guidelines.
  • Drive global process optimization, harmonization, and digitalization initiatives within operational procurement, expanding best practices from Germany to other ACEMEA locations; actively contribute to training, coaching, and knowledge sharing across the region.
  • Ensure implementation and monitoring of internal controls and compliance requirements in alignment with corporate governance.
  • Take ownership for KPI management and reporting; lead regular performance reviews and ensure continuous improvement in collaboration with VP Procurement, Procurement Directors, and Commodity Management.
  • Develop the team’s capabilities through Talent Management, career path planning, and competency building; promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and service orientation.
  • Manage audits, key projects, and initiatives impacting procurement operations across the region.

Qualifications:

  • Degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or comparable qualification.
  • Several years of experience in operational procurement in an international industrial environment.
  • Proven leadership skills, ideally with experience in managing teams across regions / cultures.
  • In-depth knowledge of procurement processes, ERP systems (SAP is a plus), and reporting tools (Excel, Power BI).
  • Understanding of compliance frameworks, internal controls, and quality standards.
  • Analytical, structured, and pragmatic working style with strong solution orientation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language is a plus.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
